# receipts

> A GitHub template that keeps a weekly, evidence-backed record of what you shipped. Once a week, Claude Code reads your git history and your Claude Code sessions and writes up the work, with dates, commit hashes, PRs and measured results. The output is a running record for performance reviews, promotion packets and 1:1s, plus plain-language pages you can show a manager. Everything runs locally; nothing is uploaded. MIT licensed.

How it works:

- `./scripts/run-weekly.sh --no-ai` collects evidence (commits, +/- lines, PRs, ticket keys, Claude Code sessions, test results) and writes a facts-only draft note. No AI, no tokens.
- `/weekly-update` in Claude Code writes up every pending draft, oldest first: a dated weekly note, the per-project topic files and the share pages.
- `./scripts/run-weekly.sh` does both unattended; on macOS a launchd job runs it on Mondays at 10:00. On Linux, use cron.
- Each run covers everything since the last one (`state.json`), so a missed week just makes the next window longer. The first run covers the last 30 days.

Requirements: Claude Code, Python 3 and git. The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is optional and is used to read PR details. Keep your copy private: it describes your employer's work.

Outputs:

- `weekly/<since>_to_<until>.md`: one engineering-level note per week.
- `topics/NN-*.md`: one living file per project.
- `share/`: static pages for non-technical readers (Summary, Timeline, Week, Area). They make no network requests and work straight from disk.

Passwords, tokens, keys, private IPs and connection strings are redacted from the collected evidence. Only the user's own commits and sessions are credited.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/README.md): setup, configuration keys, running, scheduling and customizing
- [The /weekly-update procedure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/.claude/commands/weekly-update.md): the write-up rules Claude follows
- [config.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/config.json): who you are and which repos count as work (edit this first)

## Demo

- [Live demo](https://vatsal.xyz/receipts/demo/): the share pages filled with six weeks of made-up data for a fictional engineer
- [Demo data](https://vatsal.xyz/receipts/demo/data.json): the share/data.json that drives the demo pages

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts)
- [Create a copy from the template](https://github.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/generate)
- [scripts/collect.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/scripts/collect.py): gathers evidence from git and Claude Code sessions, with redaction
- [scripts/draft.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/scripts/draft.py): writes the facts-only weekly draft
- [scripts/build-share.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/scripts/build-share.py): validates share/data.json and builds share/data.js

## Optional

- [scripts/run-weekly.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/scripts/run-weekly.sh): the headless weekly run
- [topics/_TEMPLATE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/topics/_TEMPLATE.md): layout for a new project file
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trivedi-vatsal/receipts/main/LICENSE): MIT
